verdict.rationale: The only first-party install evidence is a curl-piped shell script (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh). That is a quick installer, but it is not a standard package manager such as brew, apt, winget or pip. The community mention of ROCm containers and the Python/JS client libraries are adjacent: neither installs the runtime itself through a package manager. No evidence shows the runtime being distributed through a standard package manager.
